text:
I built Sora's hurt animations from your concept sheet on his 3D model, in our sprite style. Please review them and give suggestions. Do NOT generate an image - just reply with text.




Attached: (1) the built sprites, (2) your concept sheet for reference.




The built sheet, row by row (he faces screen right; the hit comes from the right):

- Row 1, ground hit (4 drawings): snap back, deepest lean, recovering halfway, nearly back to the battle idle.

- Row 2, air hit (2 drawings): snap back in mid-air with the legs hanging, then drifting back and tipping over.

- Row 3, head-first fall (3 drawings): tipping over while turning away, upside down with his back to the screen and his feet in the air, then the shoulders heading for the floor.

- Row 4, knockdown (3 drawings): shoulders hit the floor with the legs still up, settling, lying flat on his back face up (the final held pose).




My director's corrections so far: legs mostly straight (with a slight knee bend) in rows 2 and 3; the knees must always bend the natural way (your concept poses 5-6 had the legs facing the wrong way); ankles straight on the air drift drawing.




Please be honest and specific. For each row, say what reads well and what should change, with concrete pose changes (which body part, which direction, roughly how much). Also say whether any transitions between drawings or between rows feel too abrupt and whether extra in-between drawings are needed. Keep the list short and prioritized.
